basic_details.job_title: SCTIMST Project Technical Support III Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for one Project Technical Support III post at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Trivandrum, will be held on 11 December 2026; reporting time is 10:00 am and the interview starts at 11:30 am. Candidates report at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS Building, SCTIMST, Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram. The single vacancy is an ST backlog post (eligible UR candidates will be considered only in the absence of eligible ST candidates) in an ICMR-funded clinical trial, and the monthly emoluments are Rs. 28000/- + 20% HRA.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 Years as on 01.12.2026. Age relaxation up to 5 years shall be granted to candidates having experience of working in Government Research Organisation, in line with ICMR Order No. 16/29/2023/Admin/E.Office No.157401 dated 18.10.2024 point (h).

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About SCTIMST
content_sections.text: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology, Trivandrum, is located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, and describes itself as an Institution of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India. This notice was issued through its Research & Publication Cell for an ICMR Funded Project entitled "Comparative efficiency of Maintenance immunomodulatory therapies in Myelin Oligodendrocyte Glycoprotein associated disease- an open label randomized controlled trial with blinded outcome (CEM-MOG Study)" (P-5523).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: SCTIMST is filling one post of Project Technical Support III - (Temporary). The vacancy is an existing ST backlog vacancy. In the absence of eligible ST candidates, eligible UR candidates will be considered. MSc Clinical Research and Regulatory Affairs (or) MSc Nursing (or) MSc/MA Psychology (or) M Pharm 2 years experience in Clinical Research Experience in conducting clinical trials Experience in handling software used in clinical trials The age limit is 35 Years as on 01.12.2026. Age relaxation up to 5 years shall be granted to candidates having experience of working in Government Research Organisation, in line with ICMR Order No. 16/29/2023/Admin/E.Office No.157401 dated 18.10.2024 point (h). The monthly emoluments are Rs. 28000/- + 20% HRA. The appointment is Temporary (Purely on contract), initially for a period till 20 January 2027, and is likely to be extended till 9 March 2029 or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: SCTIMST PROJECT TECHNICAL SUPPORT III - (TEMPORARY) Job Description
content_sections.text: As printed in the notice, the Project Staff will: Be responsible for managing and coordinating clinical trial related activities Be involved in participant recruitment and screening, scheduling study visits and obtaining informed consent Maintain study documentation and ensure accurate data collection and entry into Electronic Data Capture (EDC) Monitor overall study progress, report adverse events and maintain confidential records

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Bio-data Original certificates to prove age, qualification and experience Copies of certificates to prove age, qualification and experience

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: The mode of selection is a walk-in interview. Candidates who fulfil the requirements may report at 10:00 am on 11 December 2026 at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS building, and the interview is scheduled for 11:30 am. No prior application is mentioned in the notice; candidates attend directly with the documents listed above.

content_sections.heading: Important Links
content_sections.text: For queries, the notice gives the Research & Publication Cell phone numbers 0471-2524437/637 and email [email protected] . faq.question: Q1. When is the SCTIMST Project Technical Support III walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 11 December 2026 at 11:30 am, with reporting time at 10:00 am.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the venue of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report at the Ground floor of the AMCHSS Building, Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST) at Medical College Campus, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, an existing ST backlog post; eligible UR candidates will be considered only if no eligible ST candidate is available.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates need MSc Clinical Research and Regulatory Affairs, MSc Nursing, MSc/MA Psychology or M Pharm, along with 2 years experience in Clinical Research.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years as on 01.12.2026.

faq.question: Q6. Who gets age relaxation?
faq.answer: Candidates having experience of working in a Government Research Organisation get age relaxation up to 5 years, in line with ICMR Order No. 16/29/2023/Admin/E.Office No.157401 dated 18.10.2024 point (h).

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of SCTIMST Project Technical Support III?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 28000/- + 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the emoluments as Rs. 28000/- plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is Temporary (Purely on contract), initially till 20 January 2027, and likely to be extended till 9 March 2029 or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents should be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their Bio-data, original certificates and copies of certificates to prove age, qualification and experience.
